author: Print Services
short_description: Printer shows 13.20 paper jam but no paper is stuck
text: If the 13.20 jam persists after the tray is clear, clear the stuck print jobs from the queue, then restart the print spooler.

author: Meeting Rooms / AV
short_description: Meeting room cannot join Zoom, panel frozen
text: Restart the room app first. If the panel is still frozen, reboot the codec.

author: Network / Wireless
text: Reboot the AP through the controller. If it does not come back, power-cycle the PoE port.

author: AV / Digital Signage
short_description: Lobby signage black after a CMS update
text: Re-push the schedule from the CMS to the player.

author: contractor
text: Draft: keep a spare panel in the AV cupboard on each floor.
